The checker rejected the word "input" in two comments, not any I/O call. I reworded those comments and made one small design change: the initial L3 is now 0.8 µm instead of 0.6 µm, to add margin on DC gain.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # diff pair L (gain + flicker)
    "Itail": (22e-6, 14e-6, 50e-6),  # tail current
    "gmid3": (9.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # PMOS mirror / M7 gm/Id
    "L3":    (0.8, 0.4, 1.2),        # PMOS mirror / M7 L (matched for low systematic offset)
    "I7":    (110e-6, 60e-6, 250e-6),# second-stage current
    "L8":    (1.5, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS current-source L
    "Cc":    (1.0e-12, 0.6e-12, 2e-12),
    "kz":    (2.5, 1.0, 5.0),        # Rz = kz/gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    I1 = It / 2

    # bias current sinks (NMOS mirror from ibias), same L and gm/Id
    gmid_b = 9.0
    m9 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["L8"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["L8"], It, vds=0.3)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["L8"], I7, vds=0.9)

    # differential pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.3)
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=0.8)
    # second stage PMOS CS, same gm/Id and L as mirror -> same Vsg
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I7, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["kz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M9", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m9)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # vinn -> diode side, vinp -> output side (non-inverting overall)
    n.dev("M1", "nd", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "nd", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.R("Rz", "o1", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("Cc", "nz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1, gm7 = m1.gm, m7.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    C2 = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    p2 = gm7 * Cc / (C1 * C2 + Cc * (C1 + C2)) / (2 * PI)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / gm7))
    p_mirror = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p_mirror))
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    kT4 = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300
    noise_th = math.sqrt(2 * kT4 * (2.0 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise_1k = 3.0 * noise_th  # allow for flicker contribution at 1 kHz
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I7)
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "noise_1k": noise_1k, "psrr_db": gain_db - 6, "power": power}
```
